messages.subject: Renjin & Java 7?
parts:
Hi All,

I've begun experimenting with using MethodHandles, part of the new Java 7 invokedynamic support to replace some of the very heavy code generation we currently do at compile time to expose static methods as R functions. Is there anyone out there for whom Java 6 compatibility is must for Renjin?

Let me know,

Alex
